laws.rule: Hoan Kiem Lake walking zone (evenings around the lake and nearby old quarter streets): Hanoi's 2022 rules ask everyone in the zone to dress neatly and behave politely, and ban riding or parking vehicles in it, bringing pets or livestock, walking or lying on the lawns, picking flowers or climbing trees, swimming or fishing in the lake, gambling, littering or urinating outside set places, writing on or sticking flyers to monuments, hawking or pestering people to buy, and loudspeakers or drums without a permit.
laws.heading: Quy chế quản lý hoạt động trong không gian đi bộ khu vực hồ Hoàn Kiếm và phụ cận (Decision 21/2022/QĐ-UBND, in force from 27 May 2022)

sources.title: Hà Nội ban hành quy chế quản lý phố đi bộ hồ Hoàn Kiếm và phụ cận (19 May 2022)
sources.authority: Government of Vietnam e-newspaper, Hanoi section (thanglong.chinhphu.vn)

local-law.note: A search snapshot of the national legal database lists Decision 21/2022 as no longer in force, possibly replaced after the 2025 local government changes; a replacement text was not found. Opening hours are not in the source and change for holidays and events.
